_doc: Per-pitch level trims in dB {track: {midi pitch: dB}} (score_to_parts.py PITCH_TRIMS; '_all_arts': every articulation, '_arts': only these rows; pizz. trims are steps). c01 (critic B #1): horn residuals on the 1FH KS Master at flat CC1/CC11 (Horn 4 E3 +4.2, Horn 3 B3 -3.2, G sharp 4 -4.0/-7.6, F sharp 4 -4.0/-3.7, E4 +2.7/+5.3, Horn 4 F sharp 3 -4.9). c01 (critic A #5): Double basses pizz. residuals by pitch (A1 +6.6, A1+A2 +5.7, G sharp 1 +5.4, E1 -2.0, E2 -2.4). Simultaneous notes' trims add in the envelope, so the div. pizz. octaves (bars 253-268) take their trim from the lower note only: no 44/45 entries (A1+A2 would have summed to -11 dB against a +5.7 residual). c02 (critic B #6): Violoncellos pizz. residuals by pitch over 50 single notes (G2 +8.4, F sharp 2 +8.1, D sharp 2 +7.9, G sharp 2 +5.7, B2 +1.4 with a 4.4 dB spread): G2/F sharp 2/D sharp 2 -6, G sharp 2 -4, B2 -3. c03 (critic A #4): clarinet Leg Slur body residuals per pitch at one CC (Clarinet 1 G sharp 4 -5.8, B4 -3.5, A4 +4.0, C5 +3.2; Clarinet 2 C sharp 4 -6.6), about two thirds trimmed; the rows include Leg Slur Rep (c03 ROW_REMAP). c04: critic C #4 Clarinet 1 B4 3 -> 7.5, C#5 +4.5, D#5 -2.5, G#5 -3.5, A5 -4 (two thirds of the measured body residuals in both trio statements). c06 (critic A #6): Clarinet 1 B4 7.5 -> 4.5 (B4 bumped 5-7 dB over its neighbours).
_c11: c11: B #1 Clarinet 1 _skip_onsets + 624 627 634 638 639 646 648 657 658 660 661 (accompaniment under the violins' tune)
_c14: c14: B #2 basses' pizz. E1 +2 -> 0, E2 +1 -> 0 (the EQ cuts they pushed against are gone; the div. octaves take both); B #5 Flute 1's staccato row B4 +6, D5 +5, B5 +3.
